ns2:section.sectionText: Learn statistical methods for applied economics. Focus will be on answering questions with the multiple regression model. We cover common econometric problems. The course also covers an introduction to the statistical language R. All exercises will be conducted in R and RStudio, but no prior experience in R is expected or required. . Prerequisite: MATH 124 or MATH 125; ACE 261 or ACE 262 or ECON 202 or equivalent. ACE 264 restricted to ACE students until Nov. 25 at 10:00am.
